name: Sasahara Aya
source: Aya looks more and more like her mother and notices the way her father looks at her. She knows he's interested in her body so she tries to tempt him by wearing little clothing or exposing her breasts but he shows a great deal of restraint. So on her birthday she decides not to wait any longer and drugs his wine.
